# What "good" looks like — the spec to hold vendors to

From the founder, 12 Sep 2026. Production & Ops asks every vendor about these.

- **Export or hotel grade.** Not the cheap domestic line.
- **Wooden veneer inner tray, not cardboard.** This is the one that gets
  quietly substituted — check the sample by hand.
- **Poplar or aspen splints.** Even length, no bent sticks.
- **Black head, carbonised stick.**
- **"One-strike, damp-proof"** — the phrase the trade uses for the good stuff.
  Use their words on the call; it signals you know what you're asking for.

## Why this matters to the numbers
The tray is the part bought in bulk and reused across drops. Paying a little
more per tray for veneer and even splints is a one-time cost spread over
Drop 01, 02 and 03. The printed outer box is where the per-drop money goes.
